units.source_text: 且说藤壶妃子即将册立为皇后，其仪式预定在七月间举行。

en.t: Now Lady Fujitsubo was soon to be installed as Empress, and the ceremony was scheduled to take place in the seventh month.

units.source_text: 源氏公子由中将升任了宰相。

en.t: Prince Genji was promoted from Middle Captain to Counselor.

units.source_text: 皇上准备在近年内让位于弘徽殿女御所生的太子，而立藤壶妃子所生之子为太子。

en.t: The Emperor intended within the next few years to abdicate in favor of the Crown Prince born to the Kokiden Consort, and then to make Lady Fujitsubo's son the new Crown Prince.

units.source_text: 然而这新太子没有后援人，外家诸舅父都是皇子，但已降为臣下。

en.t: Yet this new Crown Prince had no strong supporter; his maternal uncles were all imperial princes, but they had already been reduced to the rank of subjects.

units.source_text: 当时乃藤原氏之天下，未便教源氏的人摄行朝政，所以不得不将新太子的母亲册立为皇后，借以加强新太子的势力。

en.t: At the time power belonged to the Fujiwara clan, and it was not convenient to let Genji's people administer the government, so the Emperor had no choice but to install the new Crown Prince's mother as Empress in order to strengthen the boy's position.

units.source_text: 弘徽殿女御闻知此事，大为不悦，此亦理之当然。

en.t: When the Kokiden Consort heard of this, she was deeply displeased, and that too was only natural.

units.source_text: 皇上对她说道：“你的儿子不久便即位了，那时你就安居皇太后的尊位，你放心吧。”

en.t: The Emperor said to her, "Your son will soon ascend the throne; then you will rest securely in the honored rank of Empress Dowager, so set your mind at ease."

units.source_text: 世人不免过虑，纷纷议论道：“这女御是太子的母亲，入宫已有二十余年。

en.t: People could not help worrying too much, and they said among themselves, "This consort is the Crown Prince's mother and has been at court for more than twenty years.

units.source_text: 要册立藤壶妃子为皇后而压倒她，恐怕是困难的吧。”

en.t: To install Lady Fujitsubo as Empress and place her above that consort will probably be difficult."
